falsification_conditions.condition: Price closes above the 200-day moving average by 5% or more within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A strong breakout would invalidate the HOLD signal, indicating a trend reversal contrary to the current verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score increases to 70 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant rise in blowoff score would contradict the current HOLD, suggesting a confirmed blowoff top rather than an unknown phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Volume spikes to 200% above the 30-day average while price surges 10% or more in a single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a dramatic volume-price divergence would falsify the HOLD signal, indicating a confirmed market move contrary to the current unknown phase.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
